name: overpowering-defense-cannot-be-activated-without-an-attacking-guardian
notes: The generated 'Activate only if a Guardian unit you control is attacking' prereq was emitted into $cardActivatedPrereqs, a table nothing consulted, so the card could be activated any time. ActivationBlockedBeforeAnnounce() and CanActivateCardForSelection() now consult it (39 cards had prereqs in that table: legal-target gates, additional-cost payability, phase/Fatestone/Spirit restrictions).

rulesClauses: Activate this card only if a Guardian unit you control is attacking.

engineBug.summary: Overpowering Defense could be activated while no Guardian was attacking.
